posts.title: Cafe.28
posts.description: Dublin, Ireland This cafe is attached to The Mercantile hotel where we stayed. It’s right on the corner with only a handful of seats. They offer plenty of standard coffee drinks, several quick food options, and overall a nice little place. We split a ham and cheese toasty and each got an oat milk cappuccino. Everything was very good.

posts.title: Kaffeine
posts.description: Ennis, Ireland Our bus tour to Cliffs of Moher and Limerick stopped here for lunch. I needed a pick-me-up and found this coffee shop open. It’s a nice space with plenty of seating, good branding, and just down the road from a 13th century friary. I ordered a mocha and it was too hot to drink. It first tasted like steamed milk only.
